Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work reveals electric-field-induced deformation in PAM hydrogel electrolytes via Zn–O/Zn–N adhesion, causing interfacial separation and reduced battery life. item.title: Particle Size Dictates Transport Mechanism and Performance in Li 6 PS 5 Cl Conversion Cathodes for All‐Solid‐State Batteries
item.description:
این پژوهش نشان می‌دهد اندازه ذرات Li6PS5Cl در کاتدهای تبدیل، ظرفیت دسترس‌پذیر و سازوکار انتقال لیتیوم را تعیین می‌کند و کاتد بهینه چگالی انرژی 1096 Wh kg−1 با پایداری چرخه عالی ارائه می‌دهد.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Particle size non-monotonically governs Li transport in Li₆PS₅Cl conversion cathodes: rate capability first drops, then recovers in the ultrafine regime, alongside cycling stability. This reveals an interfacial job-sharing mechanism adding coupled ion/electron transport, distinct from degrading bulk pathways. The optimized cathode achieves 1096 Wh kg⁻¹ with ~100% capacity retention over 100 cycles, resolving whether LPSCl conversion enables high-capacity all-solid-state energy storage.
🏷 all-solid-state battery · Li6PS5Cl · conversion cathode · particle size · ion transport

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers a crystallinity regulation strategy for ionic liquid-based quasi-solid polymer electrolytes, tuning PMMA/PVDF-HFP ratios to co-optimize transparency and ionic transport. The optimal membrane achieves 88.2% transmittance, 1.91×10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹ conductivity, and 0.55 Li⁺ transference number, enabling flexible transparent lithium-ion batteries with 300-cycle lifespan, 61.2% transparency, and 44.8 µWh cm⁻² energy density—advancing high-performance flexible transparent energy storage.
🏷 quasi-solid electrolyte · ionic liquid · crystallinity regulation · flexible transparent battery · PMMA

Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely bridges fundamental electrochemistry and rational design of single-atom catalysts (SACs) across diverse metal-sulfur batteries, from Li-S to emerging Na-S, Al-S, K-S, Zn-S, and Mg-S systems. It highlights d–p orbital hybridization mechanisms governing bidirectional sulfur redox kinetics, offering critical insights and future directions for high-energy-density, long-lifespan M-S electrochemistry.

item.title: Long-duration aqueous manganese metal anode by hydrogel solvation regulation
item.description:
هیدروژل حاوی 18-crown-6 با کاهش هیدراتاسیون Mn2+ از 5.51 به 1.39، واکنش‌های پارازیتی آب را مهار کرده و آند منگنز آبی با عمر طولانی را ممکن می‌سازد.
Science Advances | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a hydrogel electrolyte with 18-crown-6 macrocycles that reshape Mn²⁺ solvation, cutting hydration from 5.51 to 1.39 and enabling water-repelling ion transport. It suppresses hydrogen evolution and Mn corrosion, delivering 95% Coulombic efficiency over 350 cycles, 1800-hour cycling, and durable pouch cells. This offers a promising solvation-regulation strategy for practical aqueous manganese metal batteries.
🏷 aqueous manganese battery · hydrogel electrolyte · solvation regulation · 18-crown-6 · Mn anode
